about: state-lower contests of 2024 in Indiana, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

in_enr.name: Indiana Election Division, Indiana Election Results, November 2024 General Election (the results site's archive)
in_enr.licence: no licence printed; the page's footer reads 'Copyright 1989 - <year>. Quest Information Systems, Inc. All Rights Reserved.' (the site's maker); the counts are the state's certified results
in_enr.note: the state's results files, marked certified in its settings ('Certified': 'T'); 119 JSON files (the 116 office and county files 5,460,060 bytes), read by pipeline/intake/in_enr.py; the site lists no write-in totals
